feature_flag_semantics: window_is_anomaly indicates whether the complete sequence was classified as anomalous using the saved overall reconstruction-error threshold. It is repeated across feature rows for context and is not an independent anomaly decision for each feature.
feature_error_method: Mean squared scaled reconstruction error over the window's time steps, calculated separately for each feature.
contribution_method: A feature's mean squared scaled reconstruction error divided by the sum of feature errors in the same window, expressed as a percentage.
warning: Feature contributions are reconstruction-error attributions, not causal explanations. Windows overlap and are not independent observations. Results describe this dataset only and do not establish real-world detection performance.
